label: futabainvite1
title_zh: 十四行诗 第 18 首

lines.en: label futabainvite1:
I tap on Futaba’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Futaba 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: This will be the first time I’ve ever tried inviting her over to the house and, if there’s anything I know about that girl by now, I’m pretty sure I’m about to give her a minor heart attack.
lines.zh: 这将是我第一次试着邀她来家里；而如果说我对那女孩还有什么了解的话，我很确定接下来会让她小小地心脏骤停一下。

lines.en: But hey, if things are ever going to progress to the point where we can actually have sex, events like this are going to need to happen.
lines.zh: 不过话又说回来，要是事情真想进展到我们能上床的地步，这种事就非发生不可。

lines.en: Plus, having to deal with a possessive and jealous redhead might be a good exercise in self-control and confidence for her.
lines.zh: 再说，让她面对一个占有欲强又爱吃醋的红发女孩，对她来说大概也是一场自制力与自信的锻炼。

lines.en: All of us have something to gain out of this.
lines.zh: 我们每个人都能从中得到点什么。

lines.en: A notch in the belt for me, a new outlook on life for Futaba, and a new rival for Ami.
lines.zh: 我多一道战功，Futaba 多一种人生视角，Ami 多一个对手。

lines.en: Everyone wins.
lines.zh: 皆大欢喜。

lines.en: Except Ami, I guess.
lines.zh: 大概除了 Ami。

lines.en: But she loses virtually every time I invite someone new over.
lines.zh: 不过每次我带新人回家，她基本上都输。

lines.en: Sorry, Ami.
lines.zh: 抱歉啊，Ami。

lines.en: : Hello? [futabamaster]?
lines.zh: : 喂？[futabamaster]？

lines.en: : How are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : I’m doing fine. Are you busy today?
lines.zh: : 我挺好的。你今天忙吗？

lines.en: : Today? Umm...not really. Why?
lines.zh: : 今天？嗯……不怎么忙。怎么了？

lines.en: : I was wondering if you’d want to hang out at my place.
lines.zh: : 我在想你愿不愿意来我家玩。

lines.en: : Y-y-your...your house?!
lines.zh: : 你、你、你的……你家？！

lines.en: : But...it’s...so sudden! I mean...we haven’t even-
lines.zh: : 可……这也……太突然了！我是说……我们连……

lines.en: : W-wait...this is...this is to study or something, right?
lines.zh: : 等、等等……这……这是为了学习什么的，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, of course it’s something like that.
lines.zh: : 对，当然是为了那种事。

lines.en: : You live with Ami and have already...decided to not really {i}teach{/i} as much lately, so...
lines.zh: : 你和 Ami 住在一起，而且最近……已经决定不太{i}教{/i}课了，所以……

lines.en: : You probably just need someone to help her with English, right?
lines.zh: : 你大概只是需要有人帮她补英语，对吧？

lines.en: : You definitely don’t want to just {i}hang out{/i} with me, hahahaha~
lines.zh: : 你肯定不是单纯想和我{i}待在一起{/i}，哈哈哈哈~

lines.en: : Right?...
: I actually did, but the studying thing sounds like a good cover story.
lines.zh: : 其实我还真是这么想的，不过学习这个借口听起来挺不错。

lines.en: : So...wait, what am I doing?
lines.zh: : 那么……等等，我在干什么来着？

lines.en: : Do I need to bring my books?
lines.zh: : 我需要带书吗？

lines.en: : Bring whatever you want. We’ll deal with it once you get there.
lines.zh: : 想带什么就带什么。等你到了再说。

lines.en: : Wait, [futabamaster]!
lines.zh: : 等等，[futabamaster]！

lines.en: I hang up the phone and put it back into my pocket.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，把它塞回口袋。

lines.en: I guess that call went more or less how I expected it to.
lines.zh: 那通电话大体上和我预想的一样。

lines.en: scene black
All that matters is that Futaba agreed to show up.
lines.zh: 重要的是 Futaba 答应来了。

lines.en: And it’s not like her coming over will be as rattling for Ami as someone like Chika since the two of them are already in a club together.
lines.zh: 而且她来我家对 Ami 的冲击应该不会像 Chika 那种人那么大，毕竟她们俩已经在同一个社团里了。

lines.en: If anything, we can just fall back on the makeshift tutor idea Futaba was smart enough to come up with-
lines.zh: 实在不行，我们还可以退回到 Futaba 聪明地想出来的那个临时家教的点子上——

lines.en: Even if the manner in which she came up with it was the direct result of her poor confidence rearing its ugly head once more.
lines.zh: 尽管她想出这个点子的方式，正是她那可怜的自信心又一次探头作祟的直接结果。

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy1
: Wow...
: I can’t believe...I’m actually here...
lines.zh: : 真不敢相信……我真的来了……

lines.en: : I mean...I’ve stopped here once or twice before to lend Ami manga but...this feels so much different...
lines.zh: : 我是说……我以前也顺路来过一两次给 Ami 送漫画，不过……这次感觉完全不一样……

lines.en: : I wonder if any of that has to do with how I’ve seen you naked and Ami hasn’t.
lines.zh: : 我在想，这会不会跟我看过你的裸体、而 Ami 没看过有关。

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy2
: Umm...I’m sorry but, if anything, Ami has probably seen me without clothes on even more than you have...
lines.zh: : 嗯……抱歉，不过要说的话，Ami 看过我没穿衣服的样子大概比你还多……

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Just what the hell is the relationship between you two?
lines.zh: : 你们俩到底是什么关系啊？

lines.en: : We’re both girls and share the same locker room for PE...
lines.zh: : 我们都是女孩子，体育课共用同一间更衣室……

lines.en: : Oh right. The promised land that only I am unable to enter.
lines.zh: : 哦对。那片唯独我进不去的应许之地。

lines.en: : R-Right...
lines.zh: : 是、是啊……

lines.en: : But at this rate, you’ll probably find a way to get in eventually, so...yeah.
lines.zh: : 不过照这个势头，你大概迟早能找到办法进去的，所以……嗯。

lines.en: : One can only hope.
lines.zh: : 只能这么指望了。

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy3
: I’ll...put in a good word for you...
lines.zh: : 我……会帮你说说好话的……

lines.en: : And I will continue to give you straight A’s in return.
lines.zh: : 作为回报，我会继续给你全 A。

lines.en: : Let it be known that this is not a bribe and that I would have done that anyway.
lines.zh: : 在此声明这不是贿赂，而且我本来也会这么做。

lines.en: : Of course you would have...
lines.zh: : 您当然会了……

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy4
: So, umm...I don’t know how serious you were about the studying thing so...I kind of just brought all of my books...
lines.zh: : 那个，嗯……我不知道您说学习的事有多认真，所以……我差不多把所有的书都带来了……

lines.en: : All of them? Aren’t there like, five?
lines.zh: : 全部？不是只有五本吗？

lines.en: : There are a lot more than five books, [futabamaster]...and I’m pretty sure you know that.
lines.zh: : 书可比五本多多了，[futabamaster]……而且我猜您心里清楚。

lines.en: : School has too many subjects.
lines.zh: : 学校的科目太多了。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’m starting to see why you may have given up on teaching all of a sudden...
lines.zh: : 是啊……我开始明白你为什么会突然放弃教课了……

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy5
: Oh, Futaba. What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，Futaba。你怎么在这儿？

lines.en: : Did I forget to give back some manga or something?
lines.zh: : 是我忘了还你漫画什么的吗？

lines.en: : No...that’s not it.
lines.zh: : 不……不是的。

lines.en: : Sensei just thought it might be a good idea to have someone come and help you with...one of the more than five subjects at our[school].
lines.zh: : Sensei 只是觉得，找个人来帮你补一补我们[school]那「五门以上」科目中的某一门，也许是个好主意。

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy6
: What? Why do you suddenly care about my education?
lines.zh: : 什么？你怎么突然关心起我的学业了？

lines.en: : Because I am a good [uncle].
lines.zh: : 因为我是一个好[uncle]。

lines.en: : I thought you were gonna let me just steal all of the answers from you for the next couple years.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你会让我接下来几年直接从你那儿抄答案呢。

lines.en: : For the rest of eternity, more likely.
lines.zh: : 更可能是永远。

lines.en: : Uhh...[high_school] doesn’t last an eternity, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 呃……[high_school]又不会永远持续下去，Sensei……

lines.en: : Are you sure about that, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗，Futaba？

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy7
: So, where did you want to start? There aren’t really any subjects I’m weak at, so pretty much anywhere would be fine.
lines.zh: : 那么，你想从哪里开始？我没有什么特别弱的科目，所以从哪儿开始都行。

lines.en: : What is iambic pentameter, then? Go.
lines.zh: : 那什么是抑扬格五音步？说吧。

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy8
: Huh? No one my age would have any idea what that is.
lines.zh: : 哈？我这年纪的人不可能知道那是什么。

lines.en: : Take a guess.
lines.zh: : 猜猜看。

lines.en: : I don’t know...some kind of medical thingy used to measure...blood?
lines.zh: : 我不知道……某种用来测……血的医疗器械？

lines.en: : That’s not even remotely close.
lines.zh: : 差得十万八千里。

lines.en: : I mean...some iambic pentameter is kind of like a heartbeat. So if you think of blood in that regard...it’s...almost a good guess?
lines.zh: : 我是说……有些抑扬格五音步确实有点像心跳。所以你要是从血那个角度去想……这……勉强算个不错的猜测？

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy9
: Why do you know that? And, better question, why does {i}Sensei{/i} know that?
lines.zh: : 你怎么会知道这个？还有更关键的问题，{i}Sensei{/i} 为什么会知道？

lines.en: : He can’t even remember what days we’re supposed to take the garbage out.
lines.zh: : 他连我们该哪天倒垃圾都记不住。

lines.en: : I’ve had to start doing it since he always forgets.
lines.zh: : 因为他老忘，我只好自己开始倒。

lines.en: : It...appears in a lot of Shakespeare’s work. And it’s easier for me to pay attention in class when we go over things I’m interested in.
lines.zh: : 它……在莎士比亚的很多作品里都出现过。而且讲到我感兴趣的东西时，我上课更容易集中注意力。

lines.en: : Well...when we {i}used to{/i} go over things, I guess...
lines.zh: : 嗯……在我们{i}以前{/i}还讲这些的时候，我想……

lines.en: : Fine then...tell me more about this stupid pentagon thingy since I’m such an {i}idiot.{/i}
lines.zh: : 好吧……那既然我这么{i}蠢{/i}，你就再给我讲讲这个破五边形玩意儿。

lines.en: : Pentameter.
lines.zh: : 是五音步。

lines.en: : Shut up.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。

lines.en: : It’s basically...a type of rhythm you can find in a poem.
lines.zh: : 基本上……就是一种在诗里能找到的节奏。

lines.en: : It’s a pattern of stressed and unstressed syllables that are measured out in fives.
lines.zh: : 它是重读和非重读音节按五个一组排成的模式。

lines.en: : And some of the ones that directly alternate sound a lot like...heartbeats.
lines.zh: : 而有些直接交替的，听起来很像……心跳。

lines.en: : Are you...familiar with Sonnet 18, Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami，你……熟悉十四行诗第 18 首吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...I don’t think so...
lines.zh: : 呃……应该不熟……

lines.en: : I don’t need to learn the other seventeen first, do I?
lines.zh: : 我不用先学前十七首吧？

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy10
: Hahah...of course not.
lines.zh: : 哈哈……当然不用。

lines.en: : Just...listen to me and see if you understand.
lines.zh: : 你就……听我说，看看能不能听懂。

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy11
: Shall {b}I{/b} com{b}pare{/b} thee {b}to{/b} a {b}su{/b}mmer’s {b}day{/b}?
lines.zh: : {b}我{/b}怎么能够把你来比作{b}夏天{/b}？

lines.en: : Thou {b}art{/b} more {b}love{/b}ly {b}and{/b} more {b}tem{/b}per{b}ate{/b}-
lines.zh: : {b}你{/b}不独比它可爱也比它{b}温婉{/b}——

lines.en: : Do you see what’s happening? How every other syllable is emphasized?
lines.zh: : 你听出来了吗？每隔一个音节就有一个被重读？

lines.en: : Yeah. It does sound kinda like a heartbeat when you do it like that.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你这么一读，确实有点像心跳。

lines.en: : You remember all that off the top of your head, though?
lines.zh: : 不过这些都是你凭记忆背下来的吗？

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy12
: Mhm...
: I have a lot of time to go over little things like that when I’m in the library.
lines.zh: : 我在图书馆的时候，有大把时间反复琢磨这些细枝末节。

lines.en: : And when you read something so many times, it starts to stick in your head.
lines.zh: : 而且一样东西读得多了，它就会自己粘在脑子里。

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy13
: Plus...that’s the sonnet Sensei used to teach me about the pentameter when I was struggling with it.
lines.zh: : 而且……我当初搞不懂五音步的时候，Sensei 就是用这首十四行诗教我的。

lines.en: It’s good to see that whoever the old Sensei was had an appreciation for Shakespeare as well.
lines.zh: 看到从前的那位 Sensei 也懂得欣赏莎士比亚，挺好的。

lines.en: This is definitely a strange coincidence, though.
lines.zh: 不过这绝对是个奇怪的巧合。

lines.en: All I did was break out an advanced term that Ami wouldn’t know and the conversation quickly evolved into something of actual importance to Futaba.
lines.zh: 我不过是抛了个 Ami 不会的高级术语，话题就迅速演变成了对 Futaba 真正重要的东西。

lines.en: : Really? All he ever taught me was how he likes his eggs cooked.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？他教过我的就只有他喜欢鸡蛋怎么做。

lines.en: : Futaba is my new apprentice. You're in her hands from now on.
lines.zh: : Futaba 是我的新徒弟。从今往后你就交给她了。

lines.en: : Also, please don’t tell Makoto I said that. She’ll kill me.
lines.zh: : 还有，千万别把这话告诉 Makoto。她会杀了我的。

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy14
: Hahaha~ Of course, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈~ 当然了，Sensei……

lines.en: : I’m kind of worried about what she’d do to me as well if she ever heard that.
lines.zh: : 我也挺担心她要是听见了会怎么对我。

lines.en: : Hey...what did I tell you about using the M word in this house?
lines.zh: : 嘿……我怎么跟你说的来着，这屋里不许提那个 M 开头的词？

lines.en: scene black
scene futabaamistudy15
Futaba, having just been declared my new apprentice, spends the evening alternating between tutoring Ami and trying to hold conversations with me.
lines.zh: 刚被宣布成为我新徒弟的 Futaba，这一晚就在辅导 Ami 和试图跟我搭话之间来回切换。

lines.en: It’s an incredibly normal feeling night, something I didn’t particularly expect when I decided I’d put the two of them in the same room.
lines.zh: 这是一个感觉异常平常的夜晚——当初决定把她俩放进同一个房间时，我可没料到会这样。

lines.en: Sure, they’re both members of the manga club and have spent many hours in the same room before-
lines.zh: 诚然，她们都是漫画社的成员，以前也在同一间屋子里待过很多小时——

lines.en: But I'm beginning to understand that some of the girls act differently when I’m around.
lines.zh: 但我渐渐明白，有些女孩在我面前会表现得很不一样。

lines.en: Just like how I act differently when I’m around some of them.
lines.zh: 就像我在某些女孩面前也会不一样。

lines.en: I’m glad this worked out, though.
lines.zh: 不过我很高兴事情顺利收场了。

lines.en: Maybe Futaba can start coming here more often.
lines.zh: 也许以后可以让 Futaba 多来几次。

lines.en: : Sensei, do you have any other good examples of iambic pentameter that I could give to Ami?
lines.zh: : Sensei，您还有别的适合给 Ami 讲的抑扬格五音步的好例子吗？

lines.en: : Things that would be easy for her to understand.
lines.zh: : 就是她容易懂的那种。

lines.en: : I feel like I should be offended by that, but I still barely even understand what’s going on.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我该觉得被冒犯，不过我到现在也基本没搞懂在讲什么。

lines.en: : Richard III...Winter of our discontent.
lines.zh: : 《理查三世》……我们不满的冬天。

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy16
: Ah! Another good one!
lines.zh: : 啊！这个也好！

lines.en: : Listen closely, Ami. This one starts out like a song and then turns into a heartbeat.
lines.zh: : 仔细听，Ami。这段开头像一首歌，然后变成了心跳。

lines.en: : Think of the opening like a...short drumroll or something.
lines.zh: : 把开头想成……一小段鼓点什么的。

lines.en: : {b}Now{/b} is the {b}win{/b}ter {b}of{/b} our {b}dis{/b}con{b}tent-{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}现在{/b}是我们不满的{b}冬天{/b}——

lines.en: : Made {b}glor{/b}ious {b}sum{/b}mer {b}by{/b} this {b}sun{/b} of {b}York{/b}.
lines.zh: : 被这{b}约克{/b}之日照成了辉煌的{b}盛夏{/b}。

lines.en: : And {b}all{/b} the {b}clouds{/b} that {b}lour’d{/b} up{b}on{/b} our {b}house{/b}-
lines.zh: : {b}所有{/b}那威胁着我们家族的{b}阴云{/b}——

lines.en: : In {b}the{/b} deep {b}bo{/b}som {b}of{/b} the {b}o{/b}cean {b}bu{/b}ried.
lines.zh: : 都已深埋于{b}海洋{/b}的怀抱。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m still confused. Maybe I’m just not good at poetry.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我还是一头雾水。也许我就是不擅长诗歌。

lines.en: : There are very few people who are {i}good{/i} at poetry. But there are a lot of people who try to understand it.
lines.zh: : {i}擅长{/i}诗歌的人很少。但试图去理解它的人很多。

lines.en: : What I’m teaching you now is...less of a poetry lesson and more of a science lesson.
lines.zh: : 我现在教你的……与其说是诗歌课，不如说是科学课。

lines.en: : It’s the science of what makes things sound the way they do.
lines.zh: : 是研究事物为什么会发出这种声音的科学。

lines.en: : Kind of like...how pop music is created for the sole purpose of getting stuck in your head.
lines.zh: : 有点像……流行音乐被创作出来，唯一的目的是在你脑子里循环。

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy18
: Woah! I totally understand that part!
lines.zh: : 哇！这段我完全懂！

lines.en: : Sometimes, I’ll hear a song I don’t even know on the radio and it will get stuck in my head for pretty much the entire day. It’s crazy!
lines.zh: : 有时候我在收音机里听到一首根本不认识的歌，它就会在我脑子里转上一整天。太离谱了！

lines.en: : Exactly! Because it follows a pattern. Just like most of Shakespeare’s work does.
lines.zh: : 没错！因为它遵循一种模式。就像莎士比亚大部分作品一样。

lines.en: : That Shakespeare guy should have made a rap album. He sounds like he’d be really good at it if he stopped making up weird words all the time.
lines.zh: : 那个莎士比亚该去出张说唱专辑。他听起来很擅长，只要他别老编些怪词。

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy19
: Well...umm...he’s...kind of responsible for a lot of the words that exist today, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯……这个……今天存在的很多词其实都是他造的，所以……

lines.en: : If he stopped making them up it...probably wouldn’t have worked out as well for him...
lines.zh: : 要是他不造词的话……对他来说大概就没这么顺利了……

lines.en: : Yeah, whatever. I still don’t really get it.
lines.zh: : 好吧随便吧。我还是不太懂。

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy20
: But it’s cool that you’re so smart when it comes to this kind of stuff, Futaba! I’m really impressed!
lines.zh: : 不过 Futaba 你懂这些真是太酷了！我超佩服的！

lines.en: : Sensei should just get rid of his current class-rep and give you the job instead.
lines.zh: : Sensei 干脆把现在的班长换掉，让你来当好了。

lines.en: : At least I know you aren’t the type to perv out on him all the time.
lines.zh: : 至少我知道你不是那种成天对他发花痴的人。

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy21
: Hahah...right...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……是啊……

lines.en: : Sensei, how does that sound?
lines.zh: : Sensei，您觉得怎么样？

lines.en: : It sounds like another thing that would get all of us killed if Makoto was here right now.
lines.zh: : 听起来又是一件要是 Makoto 在场会让我们全部死无葬身之地的事。

lines.en: : Oh, stop. The only thing she’d defeat all of us in is like...a sudoku match or something.
lines.zh: : 哎呀别这样。她能赢我们的也就……数独比赛什么的。

lines.en: : Futaba would be much better than her and we’re already friends.
lines.zh: : Futaba 比她强多了，而且我们已经是朋友了。

lines.en: : Don’t you want a class-rep who can help people actually learn instead of just yelling at them all the time?
lines.zh: : 你难道不想要一个能真正帮大家学习、而不是成天冲人吼的班长吗？

lines.en: : Didn’t Futaba sound a lot like a teacher today?
lines.zh: : Futaba 今天听起来是不是特别像个老师？

lines.en: : Well, yeah...but-
lines.zh: : 嗯，是……不过——

lines.en: : I-I’m really only good at teaching subjects I like. Makoto’s a much better leader than I would ever be.
lines.zh: : 我、我只是擅长教自己喜欢的科目。Makoto 的领导才能比我强太多了。

lines.en: : So...I think she should still be the...important one.
lines.zh: : 所以……我觉得她还是应该当那个……重要的人。

lines.en: scene futabaamistudy22
: Do you hear this, Sensei? Futaba is saying she isn’t important now!
lines.zh: : Sensei 您听见了吗？Futaba 现在说自己不重要！

lines.en: : Look what you’ve done!
lines.zh: : 看看你干的好事！

lines.en: : I didn’t mean it like that...
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思……

lines.en: : I just think we should maybe...keep practicing instead of deciding who should replace Makoto...
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得我们也许该……继续练习，而不是决定谁来接替 Makoto……

lines.en: scene black
We don’t hang out for much longer after that.
lines.zh: 那之后我们没再待多久。

lines.en: Ami gets up after expelling all of her learning-energy for the day and offers to make dinner for the three of us.
lines.zh: Ami 把一天的学习精力耗尽后站起身，提议给我们三个人做晚饭。

lines.en: I guess Futaba feels like she’s overstayed her welcome as she denies the offer and decides to head home instead.
lines.zh: Futaba 大概是觉得自己待太久了，便婉拒了邀请，决定回家。

lines.en: She texts me on her way back thanking me for inviting her over again and I contemplate whether or not I should apologize for just throwing her into the deep end with Ami.
lines.zh: 她在回去的路上发短信谢谢我再次邀请她；我则在琢磨，是不是该为自己把她直接扔进 Ami 那个深水区而道歉。

lines.en: I decide against it, though.
lines.zh: 不过我决定还是算了。

lines.en: I feel like this was a good first time for Futaba.
lines.zh: 我觉得对 Futaba 来说，这第一次已经很好了。

lines.en: She didn’t have to deal with the nervousness that would be sure to come with us being alone in my room- and she even got to rant about one of the things she loves for a while.
lines.zh: 她不必承受和我单独待在房间里必然会有的那种紧张——而且她还能就自己热爱的东西滔滔不绝一阵子。

lines.en: All in all, I doubt today could have possibly gone any smoother.
lines.zh: 总而言之，我怀疑今天不可能比这更顺利了。

lines.en: I’ll have to invite her over again soon and see what happens next...
lines.zh: 我得尽快再邀她一次，看看接下来会发生什么……

lines.en: $ futabainvite1 = True
$ futaba_love += 3
{i}Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]!{/i}
